item.title: Minneapolis shooting suspect faced eviction before attack
item.description: The suspect in a mass shooting at a downtown Minneapolis apartment complex, which killed two and injured six, was facing eviction.

item.title: Ig Nobel awards honor cockroach milk and nose-blowing research
item.description: Ten teams received satirical science awards at a ceremony held outside the U.S. for the first time due to travel concerns.

item.title: Excavation for Trump's arch to start within two weeks
item.description: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced that excavation for President Trump's 'triumphal arch' will begin in the next two weeks.

item.title: ICE whistleblower cites 'unprecedented lowering of standards' in hiring
item.description: A background-check supervisor warned last year that ICE was hiring many new officers without basic vetting.
